shortDescription: Maps the Fair Work Act, NES, award and agreement layers for an employment arrangement and issue-spots termination and policy exposure. A lawyer decides every conclusion.
longDescription: Creates an approved employment profile for an Australian employer, maps which Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth), National Employment Standards, modern award and enterprise agreement provisions apply to a described employment arrangement, issue-spots unfair dismissal, general protections, redundancy and notice exposure for a proposed or completed termination with the Fair Work Commission time limits routed to the litigation-deadlines script, reviews a workplace policy set against the current statutory hooks (right to disconnect, flexible work, parental and family and domestic violence leave, fixed-term limits, positive duty, wage theft), and tracks Fair Work developments against their primary sources. It verifies official publishers, labels regulator guidance as guidance, and never concludes that a dismissal was unfair, that adverse action occurred, or that an employer is compliant.
defaultPrompt: Create a controlled employment profile for this employer before mapping its Fair Work obligations.
Map the NES, award and agreement entitlements that apply to this employee's arrangement.
Issue-spot the termination exposure for this proposed dismissal and the Fair Work Commission time limits.
Review this workplace policy set against the current Fair Work Act hooks.
Check the Fair Work watch register and tell me what has changed since our last review.
whatItDoes: Records employer type, coverage, size, instruments and governance in a controlled employment profile
Maps the Fair Work Act, NES, modern award and enterprise agreement layers to a described arrangement with evidence states
Issue-spots unfair dismissal, general protections, redundancy, notice and unlawful termination exposure with the FWC time limits flagged
Reviews a policy set against the current statutory hooks and labels each hook law or guidance
Tracks Fair Work developments against their primary sources and reports what moved
boundaries: Never concludes that a dismissal was unfair, that adverse action occurred, or that an employer is compliant
Never computes a Fair Work Commission time limit itself — candidate dates come from the litigation-deadlines script
Never drafts or lodges an application, response or agreement with the Commission or the Ombudsman
State-system employers, contractors, discrimination merits and industrial action strategy route to human or specialist review
